notes: CAM_19mm_cradle: bottom 7 mm trimmed so the pack fits under it; the camera keeps its V18 position. The cradle bolts to C1 so lifting C1 opens the nose bay.
Rear crossrail moves to x 566.5 (wing frame x 291.5): the V18 station would put it through the D1 intake. It now crosses the keels ahead of the outrigger connectors.
Plug the V18 crossrail slots in F2 that the moved crossrails leave empty (printed plugs, bond in).
Rotor booms: 10x10 carbon at y +/-220, z -37.5 to -27.5 (0.5 mm under the lowest wing skin they pass).
